title: Conference interpretation channel cutover
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Technical brief | Orbital Materials Forum
Hall A uses channel 2 for the main talk in the morning. The French booth sends interpretation on channel 4 until 10:45; the Korean booth will test channel 4 from 11:00 to 11:12 before using it during the Korean panel. The panel team did not request an audience channel during testing.

The audience signs display a channel only while it can be used to listen to an event. Staff can use the rehearsal receiver with a headset even while the channel is hidden on the audience sign. Pressing HIDE on the sign panel changes the display only. Muting the booth switches off the booth feed itself and prevents the rehearsal receiver from hearing it.

DOCUMENT 2 — Technician chat at 10:42
Niall: The French presenter has already stopped speaking, and listeners are returning headsets. The interpreter is about to read one last slide, though. Can the sign show channel 4 until the interpreter finishes?

Rina: Yes. The Korean team is already in its booth, but they asked us to keep channel 4 off the sign during the test, not to mute it. Put the rehearsal receiver on channel 4 and leave it for them.

Niall: The panel start moved to 11:18, but the test is still at 11:00. I'll go to the west entrance to help at 11:15. Please tell the new desk lead what has to happen between the test and the panel.

DOCUMENT 3 — Note to incoming desk lead at 11:13
The test has ended, and the Korean booth is still transmitting. Please show channel 4 on the audience sign once the moderator welcomes the panel audience, not when the booth technician gives us a ready signal. The booth feed should stay available to staff before that welcome.

An accessibility attendant at the front row needs a spare receiver for a separate equipment check. The receiver now at the desk has a worn volume dial; it is safe to use at the test bench but must not be issued to the audience. Fetch a different spare from the hall locker for the attendant, who will be using it to assist a guest once the panel starts.
passageZh:
文件 1｜技術簡報｜軌道材料論壇
A 廳上午使用第 2 頻道播送主講。法語口譯間會用第 4 頻道傳送口譯到 10:45。韓語口譯間會在 11:00 至 11:12 測試第 4 頻道，之後在韓語座談時使用。座談小組沒有要求在測試期間開放聽眾頻道。

只有能透過某頻道收聽活動時，現場聽眾指示牌才會顯示該頻道。即使聽眾指示牌上隱藏該頻道，工作人員仍能用彩排接收器及耳機收聽。在指示牌控制面板上按 HIDE 只改變顯示。將口譯間靜音則會關掉口譯間的訊號，彩排接收器也會收不到。

文件 2｜10:42 技術人員訊息
奈爾：法語講者已講完，聽眾正在還耳機。不過口譯員還要口譯最後一張投影片。指示牌能顯示第 4 頻道，直到口譯員講完嗎？

麗娜：可以。韓語小組已進入口譯間，但他們是要我們測試時不要在指示牌顯示第 4 頻道，不是要關掉聲音。把彩排接收器轉到第 4 頻道，留給他們。

奈爾：座談改到 11:18 開始，但測試仍是 11:00。我 11:15 要去西側入口支援。請告訴新來的服務台組長，測試結束與座談開始之間要做什麼。

文件 3｜11:13 給接班服務台組長的便條
測試已結束，韓語口譯間仍在傳送訊號。請在主持人向座談聽眾致歡迎詞後，才在聽眾指示牌顯示第 4 頻道，不要在口譯間技術人員發出準備就緒的訊號時就顯示。致詞前，口譯間訊號應維持供工作人員收聽。

前排的無障礙服務人員需要一台備用接收器做另一項設備檢查。服務台現在這台接收器的音量旋鈕已磨損，在測試台使用沒問題，但不得發給聽眾。請另從廳內置物櫃取一台備用接收器給該人員；座談開始後，他會用它來協助一位來賓。
